modules.module_title: Select a field for growing seeds

pcs.pc_description: select a field for seed production as per the seed production company’s instructions, ensuring it has adequate sunlight exposure and water for irrigation
ensure the field doesn't have high weed incidence and is free of unwanted plants from the previous season's crop
check the field has effective drainage and aeration for effective control of pest and diseases

modules.module_title: Prepare the field for growing seeds

pcs.pc_description: collect soil samples from different parts of the field for the purpose of testing
co-ordinate with the seed production company's lab to get the soil samples tested
apply the necessary treatment such as farmyard manure, compost and vermi-compost as per the lab's recommendations to enhance the soil fertility
plough and prepare the field as per the instructions of the seed production company’s field supervisor
maintain the record of soil testing and field preparation as per the documentation requirements of the seed production company

modules.module_title: Procure, test and store the seeds

pcs.pc_description: select foundation/ certified seed varieties to grow in the field as per the company’s instructions
procure healthy seeds of the selected varieties from the seed production company or a vendor approved by them
ensure the seeds are genetically pure, contamination-free and uniform in size
conduct a seed test under supervision of the field supervisor to ensure the seeds have a high germination percentage and vigour
use an appropriate method to sort out the chaffy seeds
wash the seeds with clean water to remove any unwanted materials
store the seeds under the recommended temperature and humidity as per the field supervisor’s instructions
apply the necessary treatment in the storage as per instructions to protect the seeds from pests and disease
maintain the record of the treatment applied in the storage

modules.module_title: Arrange the tools, equipment and PPE

pcs.pc_description: identify the relevant tools, equipment and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for sowing the seeds and maintaining the seedlings
arrange the tools, equipment and PPE as per the requirement
ensure the tools and equipment are in working condition
plan the sowing of seeds in a way to ensure that there are no heavy rains at the flowering stage of the seed crop and it matures in the summer season to achieve the best quality of seeds

pcs.pc_description: sow the seeds as per the field supervisor’s instructions, maintaining the recommended planting depth and density for the selected seed varieties
Maintain appropriate distances from other varieties to prevent cross-pollination
apply the recommended quantity of farmyard manure on the seeds as per the instructions
water the planted seeds with the recommended quantity of water
maintain the recommended temperature and soil moisture as per instructions to help the seeds germinate

modules.module_title: Maintain healthy growth of the seed crop

pcs.pc_description: apply water and recommended fertilizers uniformly in the appropriate quantity to maintain healthy growth of the seed crop
use the isolation distance method under supervision of the field supervisor to maintain the purity of the seed accessions at the pollination stage
implement controlled pollination practices like bagging, hand-pollinating, or using dedicated pollinator species (such as bees), where required
mount the soil near the root region of the seed crop plants to enhance their water and nutrient absorption capacity and help the plants to stand upright
apply a cover of mosquito net/ paper bags/ nylon stockings on the floral portion of the crop plants as per the bagging technique
co-ordinate with the field supervisor to identify and remove the crop plants with undesirable characteristics to maintain the genetic purity of the seeds as per the roughing method
identify varieties of weeds growing among the seed crop during various stages of their growth
remove the weeds manually or mechanically as per the field supervisor’s instructions
apply the recommended weedicides in an appropriate quantity as per the manufacturer/ field supervisor’s instructions
monitor the seed crop regularly for signs of pest/ disease infestation
apply the recommended pesticides/ insecticides as per the manufacturer/ field supervisor’s instructions to remove and control pests/ insects
drain out excess water from the field to prevent the growth of pathogens
maintain the record of use of fertilizers/ weedicides/ pesticides/ insecticides as per the seed production company’s documentation requirements

pcs.pc_description: co-ordinate with the field supervisor to check if the seed crop plants have attained complete physiological maturity for being harvested
select manual or mechanical harvesting method according to the type and quantity of seed crop and field supervisor’s instructions
harvest the seed crop ensuring minimum loss and damage to the seeds
thresh the harvested seed crop manually or mechanically as per the field supervisor’s instructions to separate the seeds from the seed crop plants
ensure the seed crop is sufficiently dry before threshing is carried out
collect seeds in appropriate bags/ baskets during harvesting
protect the seeds from contamination during harvesting and avoid mixture with other types of seeds
clean the seeds using the wet or dry cleaning method according to the type of seed crop and field supervisor’s instructions
carry out winnowing to remove stem bits, petals, husks and other flower parts and debris mixed with the seeds
carry out sieving using sieves of different gauge sizes according to the need
dry the seeds under the sun according to the quantity of seeds and conducive weather conditions
ensure to shade dry the seeds with high moisture content before exposing them to sun
protect the seeds from pests and exposure to moist air during sun drying
dry a high quantity of seeds mechanically using air blowers under supervision in a well- ventilated space
Sort seeds by size, weight, and quality to ensure uniformity in the final product
co-ordinate with the field supervisor to check the moisture content in the seeds and ensure that they have been dried to the required level
Test a sample batch to check germination rates and check for diseases, pathogens, and pests that could affect future crops
select appropriate bags as per the seed production company’s standards to pack the seeds to be sent to the seed processing plant
pack the seeds in the bags ensuring no damage to them
arrange the seeds in lots according to the variety and label them appropriately
store the packed seeds in a storage area with the required temperature and humidity before being transported
Keep detailed records of seed batches, storage duration, and conditions
stack the seed bags in the storage ensuring the seeds in the bags at the bottom don't suffer damage
store the same variety of seeds together and in the correct position

modules.module_title: Transport the seeds to the seed processing plant

pcs.pc_description: arrange an appropriate mode of transport as per the company standards to ensure the protection of seeds during transit
load the seed bags safely in the transport vehicle
maintain the record of seeds bags loaded and transported to the seed processing plant
Adhere to certification requirements set by seed regulatory bodies to maintain quality standards
Maintain accurate records of planting, inputs, harvest, and storage to trace any quality issues and comply with regulations
